sections.theory:
17.2.3.1 Reactions with Aldehydes and Ketones

Grignard reagents react with aldehydes and ketones to yield addition products. Addition product upon workup with water or dilute acid solution yield alcohols. Formaldehyde produce primary alcohol, higher aldehydes produce secondary, while ketones produce tertiary alcohols on treatment with Grignard reagents.

Self-assessmnet

Write the reaction of methylmagnesium bromide with acetaldehyde and acetone, followed by acid workup. Also write the names of products.

17.2.3.2 Reactions with Esters

Grignard reagents react with esters to yield carbonyl compounds (aldehydes and ketones). These carbonyl compounds react with more of the Grignard reagent in the same reaction mixture and yield alcohols as the final products (Section 17.2.3.1).

Tidbit

The second step, a “workup” with acid solution, occurs after our key Grignard reaction, and the remaining Grignard reagent is also destroyed by acid. Only water can also be used for workup.

a. Reaction with esters of formic acid

Ester of formic acid is also called formate ester e.g. methyl formate, ethyl formate etc. Grignard reagent react with ethyl formate (or any other formate ester), yielding an addition product. Addition product undergoes elimination and forms an aldehyde. This aldehyde further reacts with another molecule of the Grignard reagent to yield a secondary alcohol as final product.

b. Reaction with esters of higher carboxylic acids

Ester of higher carboxylic acids yield tertiary alcohol as final product. For example, ethyl propanoate reacts in the same way as ethyl formate but the end product of this reaction is a tertiary alcohol, through intermediate ketone.

17.2.3.3 Reaction with carbon dioxide

Grignard reagents react with carbon dioxide forming an addition product. Addition product upon acid workup yields carboxylic acids.

For example methylmagnesium bromide upon addition to carbon dioxide followed by acid workup results acetic acid.

دوسرا مرحلہ، یعنی تیزابی محلول سے ”ورک اپ“، ہمارے بنیادی گرینیارڈ تعامل کے بعد ہوتا ہے، اور باقی ماندہ گرینیارڈ عامل بھی تیزاب سے ختم ہو جاتا ہے۔ ورک اپ کے لیے صرف پانی بھی استعمال ہو سکتا ہے۔

b. بڑے کاربوکسیلک ایسڈز کے ایسٹرز سے تعامل

بڑے کاربوکسیلک ایسڈز کے ایسٹر آخری پیداوار کے طور پر ثالثی الکوحل دیتے ہیں۔ مثلاً ایتھائل پروپانوئیٹ ایتھائل فارمیٹ کی طرح تعامل کرتا ہے لیکن اس تعامل کی آخری پیداوار درمیانی کیٹون کے ذریعے ثالثی الکوحل ہوتی ہے۔

گرینیارڈ عاملین کاربن ڈائی آکسائیڈ سے تعامل کر کے اضافی پیداوار بناتے ہیں۔ اضافی پیداوار تیزابی ورک اپ پر کاربوکسیلک ایسڈز دیتی ہے۔

17.2.3.1 Reactions with Aldehydes and Ketones

Grignard reagents react with aldehydes and ketones to yield addition products. Addition product upon workup with water or dilute acid solution yield alcohols. Formaldehyde produce primary alcohol, higher aldehydes produce secondary, while ketones produce tertiary alcohols on treatment with Grignard reagents.

Self-assessmnet

Write the reaction of methylmagnesium bromide with acetaldehyde and acetone, followed by acid workup. Also write the names of products.

17.2.3.2 Reactions with Esters

Grignard reagents react with esters to yield carbonyl compounds (aldehydes and ketones). These carbonyl compounds react with more of the Grignard reagent in the same reaction mixture and yield alcohols as the final products (Section 17.2.3.1).

Tidbit

The second step, a “workup” with acid solution, occurs after our key Grignard reaction, and the remaining Grignard reagent is also destroyed by acid. Only water can also be used for workup.

a. Reaction with esters of formic acid

Ester of formic acid is also called formate ester e.g. methyl formate, ethyl formate etc. Grignard reagent react with ethyl formate (or any other formate ester), yielding an addition product. Addition product undergoes elimination and forms an aldehyde. This aldehyde further reacts with another molecule of the Grignard reagent to yield a secondary alcohol as final product.

b. Reaction with esters of higher carboxylic acids

Ester of higher carboxylic acids yield tertiary alcohol as final product. For example, ethyl propanoate reacts in the same way as ethyl formate but the end product of this reaction is a tertiary alcohol, through intermediate ketone.

17.2.3.3 Reaction with carbon dioxide

Grignard reagents react with carbon dioxide forming an addition product. Addition product upon acid workup yields carboxylic acids.

For example methylmagnesium bromide upon addition to carbon dioxide followed by acid workup results acetic acid.
